# VidBrief

> Free, open-source app that turns any YouTube or X video into a timestamped executive brief and reads it aloud, entirely on an Apple Silicon Mac. No API keys or cloud services.

- Pipeline: YouTube captions (or yt-dlp + MLX Whisper) → local LLM via mlx-lm (condense → plan chapters → write chapters → overview) → Kokoro text-to-speech.
- Output: High-Level Overview, Context, topic chapters with [HH:MM:SS] bullets, Key Takeaways, plus an MP3.
- Requirements: Apple Silicon Mac (16 GB recommended), Homebrew, Python 3.10+, Node 18+, espeak-ng; ~7.8 GB of models.
- License: MIT.
